nodes.title: SG-8.4.2 quality gate: context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still carries README-only text and UNKNOWN placeholders, and the checks in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts do not yet list every stale string the intent names. Desired behavior: the stack, stale-text and module-path unit tests describe and enforce the real stack (TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest, Go) and the real modules. Expected result: the contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass once context.md is regenerated. Why: the quality gate for REQ-542 and REQ-543 has failed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when the stack terms are checked, then TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go are all named and no UNKNOWN placeholder remains.
- Given the repo-root context.md, when the stale-text check runs, then 'hello Worldseed', 'no application', 'echo no build' and 'echo no test' are all reported if present.
- Given the module table, when its paths are resolved from the repo root, then game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ are listed and exist.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts stale-text contract
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts module-path contract
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and API
- Out of scope: gameplay, art or UI changes
- Out of scope: editing context.md or .ai-dlc files from Act or Verify units
- Preserve: existing STACK_TERMS values
- Preserve: existing passing tests, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: phaser pin guard test


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration)
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Stale-text and module-path helpers enforce the full contract
- The context tests pass against a regenerated context.md
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: STALE_TEXT in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts lists only 'hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index', 'Bidirectional links' and one UNKNOWN row, so 'no application', 'echo no build' and 'echo no test' pass undetected. Desired behavior: staleTextHits reports all of them, while STACK_TERMS keeps requiring TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, plus Go and no UNKNOWN in the tests. Expected result: a context.md with README-only text fails the check. Why: the quality gate REQ-542 requires it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given markdown containing 'no application', when staleTextHits runs, then it returns that string.
- Given markdown containing 'echo no build' or 'echo no test', when staleTextHits runs, then each is returned.
- Given markdown naming every STACK_TERMS entry, when missingTerms runs, then it returns an empty array.


## Scope
- In scope: STALE_TEXT constant in docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: context.md edits by Act or Verify units
- Preserve: STACK_TERMS list
- Preserve: staleTextHits signature


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration)
- No source file in game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope


## Definition of done
- STALE_TEXT includes the three new strings
- staleTextHits behaviour is covered by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists only the real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths in game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts extracts backticked game/ and backend/ paths from table rows, and missingPaths checks them against disk. Desired behavior: the documented contract names the four required rows and the existence rule. Expected result: a module table listing a path that does not exist is reported by missingPaths. Why: the quality gate REQ-543 requires only real paths.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a table row listing game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, when contextModulePaths runs, then it returns those four paths in order.
- Given a table row listing a path absent from disk, when missingPaths runs with an exists predicate returning false for it, then that path is returned.
- Given non-table lines containing game/ paths, when contextModulePaths runs, then they are ignored.


## Scope
- In scope: contextModulePaths contract in contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: context.md edits by Act or Verify units
- Preserve: contextModulePaths signature and return form


## Technical constraints
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- No source file in game/frontend/src is over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- Contract comment matches behaviour
- Module path behaviour is covered by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None
